text:
sam-cs: Heads-up — customer FinEdge reports that after last night's canary, their billing-help prompts now omit SLA language but only when routed to AP-SG h100. They attached before/after examples and say it started ~2026-04-01 01:45Z.

nina-support: can you grab request_ids and exact model variant + params? also which cluster they hit?

sam-cs: request_ids: r-20260401-11 / r-20260401-15. Model: redwood-2.1-64k (quant8). Region they hit: ap-sg-h100 pool. They say EU and US routes unchanged.

lee-eng-runtime: initial guess: new runtime rt-v2.5.1 introduced an optimized matmul kernel; maybe quant path on h100 diverges. Any telemetry for r-20260401-11?

sam-cs: customer provided minimal repro that fails ~70% on their traffic to AP-SG h100:
```
{\n  "model":"redwood-2.1-64k",\n  "temperature":0.0,\n  "max_tokens":150,\n  "prompt":"Explain FinEdge refund SLA for subscription overcharges:\n- time windows\n- refund timeline\n"\n}
```

ara-ml: can you paste the before/after outputs? even short diffs help.

sam-cs: BEFORE: "Refunds processed within 3-5 business days; disputes must be filed within 45 days; escalate to ops if charge is recurring."
AFTER (ap-sg-h100): "Contact your payment provider. Refund time varies."  <-- missing internal SLA and escalation path.

kai-sre: deploy-bot, which nodes got rt-v2.5.1 and when?

deploy-bot: rollout_event: canary/2026-04-01/rt-v2.5.1 applied to ap-sg-h100 nodes h100-3..h100-9 between 2026-04-01T01:40:12Z and 2026-04-01T01:49:02Z. 6/9 nodes in pool have new build.

lee-eng-runtime: pulling trace r-20260401-11 now. Kernel selection snapshot (sanitized):
```
[2026-04-01T01:46:33Z] trace_id=r-20260401-11 model=redwood-2.1-64k backend=rt-v2.5.1 gpu=h100-7 node=ap-sg-h100-7
token_loop: step=1 kv_cache_len=128 batch_size=6 selected_kernel=matmul_fast_v3 quant_mode=8
attention_stats: mean_abs=0.0089
output: \"Contact your payment provider. Refund time varies.\"
```

ara-ml: matmul_fast_v3 had a reorder to improve throughput on long-sequence attention; our unit tests treated outputs as functionally equivalent but they may affect FP behavior with quantized weights.

vio-devex: I'll spin a mirrored h100 instance with rt-v2.5.1 and run the minimal repro corpus across both rt-v2.5.1 and rt-v2.4.9 to diff outputs. Attaching quick results when done.

kai-sre: can we try forcing matmul_safe_v2 on the canary nodes to see if that reverts behavior? If yes, narrow to kernel.

lee-eng-runtime: scheduling a kernel-override hotfix to force matmul_safe_v2 on ap-sg-h100 canary nodes. Will replay r-20260401-11 after patch.

deploy-bot: hotfix applied: 2026-04-01T02:12:07Z -> kernel_override=matmul_safe_v2 on nodes ap-sg-h100-3..9.

sam-cs: customer reports that the same minimal request returned the expected SLA text within 8 minutes of the hotfix. They ran 20 requests and saw expected output 18/20 times after fix.

ara-ml: confirmed on internal mirror: rt-v2.5.1 + matmul_fast_v3 reproduces omission; forcing matmul_safe_v2 yields outputs matching rt-v2.4.9 baseline. Seems like a numerical stability delta in fusion ordering with quant8.

lee-eng-runtime: opening BUG-10021 with traces, kernel diffs, and synthetic repros. Action plan: (1) revert matmul_fast_v3 perf change from rt-v2.5.1 build; (2) add prompt-pattern targeted quality checks for quant8 h100 paths in CI; (3) hold matmul_fast_v3 behind opt-in A/B flag until validated.

kai-sre: ops note: no spike in 5xxs or latency. This is quality-only regression affecting a subset of quantized model executions on h100.

nina-support: marking FinEdge escalation as mitigated. We'll follow up with transparent timeline and postmortem. Customer asked for assurance before we recommit that kernel.

vio-devex: attached quick diff: 1200 synthetic prompts run -> 47 mismatches concentrated on prompts with list prefixes and short policy bullets. Will add to regression harness.

sam-cs: thanks all. I'll send customer an interim status and closure once BUG-10021 has next steps. If they see any recurrence I'll re-open. :thumbsup:
